page.overview:
Who is Anasazisaurus?

is an extinct genus of hadrosaur dinosaur that lived in New Mexico during the Late Cretaceous period. Only a partial skull has been found to date. The dinosaur was originally believed to be a specimen of Kritosaurus, but later turned out to be a new species during 1993, the year where Jurassic Park was released. It was found in the Kirtland Formation. The hadrosaur has predators like Bistahieversor and Saurornitholestes. Other herbivores that coexist with Anasazisaurus include Kritosaurus, Naashoibitosaurus, Parasaurolophus, Pentaceratops, and Stegoceras.

Anasazisaurus is illustrated by Timothy Bradley in the Dinopedia section of Jurassic Park Institute, but hasn't received a dino card before its closure in 2006. Its image can be found within the files, which may indicate that it would almost receive one. However, it would receive a profile in the website Dinosaur Earth on Dinopedia.
